guide_enrichment.narrative: For us, the case for Maryland starts with offensive stability rather than its unbeaten record. Malik Washington has completed 53 of 72 passes for 533 yards, three touchdowns and no interceptions, while Maryland has yet to commit a turnover. The supporting cast has also produced, with Na'eem Abdul-Rahim Gladding and Chris Durr Jr. combining for 18 catches, 236 yards and two touchdowns at UConn. That matters against a Virginia Tech defense our numbers rate poorly at preventing scoring opportunities.
guide_enrichment.matchup_to_watch: We are watching Maryland’s passing game against Virginia Tech’s pressure. The Hokies lead the FBS with 12 sacks through two games, so Washington’s ability to avoid negative plays will be central to whether Maryland can sustain drives. Maryland has converted 55.2 percent of its third downs so far, but Virginia Tech presents a more serious disruption test.

guide_extractions.document_match_reason: The guide identifies Game 3 as Maryland vs. Virginia Tech on Sept. 19, 2026 at SECU Stadium and contains current records, statistics and notes for both teams.

recent_game.fact: Maryland improved to 2-0 with a 38-14 road win over UConn on Sept. 12.
Maryland outgained UConn 475-223, recorded 27 first downs and held the ball for 35:31.
Maryland rushed for 125 yards and three touchdowns against UConn and produced scoring drives of 92 and 91 yards in the second quarter.
Maryland held UConn to 67 rushing yards, 156 passing yards and 12 first downs while recording five sacks and forcing one turnover.

opponent_notes.fact: Virginia Tech enters the matchup 2-0 overall and is coached by James Franklin, who is in his first season with the Hokies.
Virginia Tech quarterback Grunkemeyer has completed 48 of 62 passes for 551 yards and four touchdowns through two games.
Virginia Tech running back Overton Jr. has rushed for 151 yards at 6.57 yards per carry with two touchdowns.
Virginia Tech receiver Reynolds has 13 receptions for 158 yards and three touchdowns.
Virginia Tech leads the FBS with 12 sacks through its first two games; Maryland is tied for fourth nationally with 10.

quarterback.fact: Maryland starting quarterback Malik Washington is 53-of-72 for 533 yards, three touchdowns and no interceptions through two games.
Washington completed 34 of 41 passes for 347 yards and two touchdowns at UConn, including a Maryland-record 18 consecutive completions.
Washington's 82.9 percent completion rate against UConn was the fourth-highest single-game mark in Maryland history.
Washington started all 12 games as a true freshman in 2025 and threw for 2,963 yards and 17 touchdowns.
Backup quarterback Cardell Williams transferred from Sacramento State, where he started the final 10 games of 2025 and passed for 1,651 yards and 10 touchdowns.

offensive_personnel.fact: Maryland's offensive line against UConn consisted of left tackle Rahtrel Perry, left guard Amory Hills, center Michael Hershey, right guard Ryan Howerton and right tackle Isaiah Wright; that unit blocked for 475 total yards.
Amory Hills started at left guard against UConn after transfer Tellek Lockette started the opener at that position.
Rahtrel Perry has made 39 consecutive career starts, the most overall and consecutive starts among Maryland offensive players.
Transfer receivers Na'eem Abdul-Rahim Gladding and Chris Durr Jr. combined for 18 receptions, 236 yards and two touchdowns at UConn.
Gladding, an Old Dominion transfer, has 14 receptions for a team-high 187 yards and two touchdowns through two games.
Durr, a Wyoming transfer, has 16 receptions for 147 yards and one touchdown through two games.
USC transfer Harry Dalton III rushed for career highs of 48 yards and two touchdowns at UConn.
Iverson Howard has rushed for 121 yards and three touchdowns on 26 carries through two games.
Preston Howard, who returned to Maryland after playing at Auburn in 2025, started at tight end against UConn and caught two passes for 20 yards.

defensive_personnel.fact: Maryland added defensive linemen Lavon Johnson from Texas, Derrick LeBlanc from UCF, and Armon and Jayvon Parker from Washington through the transfer portal.
Derrick LeBlanc recorded two sacks at UConn, his first two sacks for Maryland.
DD Holmes leads Maryland with 2.5 sacks, while Eyan Thomas and Derrick LeBlanc each have two.
Sophomore Sidney Stewart recorded six tackles, 1.5 tackles for loss, one sack and a forced fumble at UConn after leading Maryland with seven sacks in 2025.
Freshman Zion Elee recorded his first career sack and forced a fumble at UConn; DD Holmes recovered the fumble.
Boston College transfer Amari Jackson and West Virginia transfer Jordan Scruggs started in Maryland's secondary at UConn and each made four tackles.
Linebacker Daniel Wingate has made 26 consecutive starts, the most among Maryland defensive players, and led the team with 102 tackles in 2025.

coaching_changes.fact: Clint Trickett took over as Maryland's offensive coordinator and quarterbacks coach after serving as Jacksonville State's offensive coordinator in 2025.
Matt Barnes returned to Maryland as special teams coordinator after two seasons as Mississippi State's co-defensive coordinator and safeties coach.
Randy Starks is Maryland's new defensive line coach, and Kyle Schmitt took over the tight ends room.

offensive_context.fact: Through two games, Maryland averages 560.5 total yards, 315.5 passing yards, 245.0 rushing yards and 50.0 points per game.
Maryland has converted 55.2 percent of its third downs through two games.
Maryland has scored nine rushing touchdowns through two games.
Maryland has committed no turnovers in either of its first two games and has won the turnover margin in both.
Maryland has two players with at least three rushing touchdowns, Harry Dalton III and Iverson Howard, while DeJuan Williams has two.

defensive_context.fact: Maryland allows 154.0 total yards, 115.5 passing yards, 38.5 rushing yards and 7.0 points per game through two games.
Maryland ranks first in the Big Ten in total defense, rushing defense and sacks through two games.
Maryland has recorded 10 sacks through two games, including five in each game.
Opponents have converted 26.9 percent of their third downs against Maryland through two games.
Maryland has held 18 consecutive opponents below 300 passing yards.

special_teams.fact: Kicker Sean O'Haire made a 19-yard field goal and all five extra-point attempts at UConn.
Na'eem Abdul-Rahim Gladding has returned two punts for 34 yards, an average of 17.0 yards per return, through two games.

series_context.fact: Maryland leads the all-time series 17-15 and has won the last two meetings.
Maryland won the most recent meeting 54-10 in 2021; Michael Locksley is 1-0 against Virginia Tech.
Virginia Tech coach James Franklin has a 9-2 career record against Maryland.

other_relevant.fact: Maryland owns a nation-leading 20-game non-conference winning streak and is 22-1 in non-conference games under Michael Locksley.
Maryland is 29-1 under Locksley when scoring at least 31 points.
Maryland has won its first two games by at least 24 points for the first time since 2021.
